description: Use when you need one report on a domain: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA) with SPF and DMARC parsed, RDAP registration for .com, .net and .org (registrar, dates, status, nameservers, DNSSEC), . Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /domain/report, $0.005 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.

domain.description: domain name, e.g. example.com (a URL is accepted; only its host is used). IP addresses and private or local names are refused

name: domain_report
title: Domain report
